destination_contract.allowed_values: Exact request-local card tokens plus UNRESOLVED
destination_contract.apply_behavior: Existing tokens map to UUIDs only after author review; UNRESOLVED remains unresolved.

observations: The v1 existing/new/unresolved object union produced zero supplied-destination accuracy in the combined vision and geometry evaluation.
A focused text-only ablation resolved all six expected destinations across the three selected Ollama models when one flat field was constrained to the request tokens plus UNRESOLVED.
Opaque C1/C2 tokens and descriptive slugs both resolved all six destinations under the flat enum, so descriptive identifiers added no measured benefit.
The flat contract preserves one multimodal call, safe abstention, request-local identifiers, and the existing author review boundary.
The live v2 multimodal comparison resolved all 24 expected cold/warm destinations across both cases and all three selected Ollama models.

model_recommendation: Retain qwen3.5:9b for end-to-end interaction and geometry reliability. The v2 flat enum removes the observed destination-resolution blocker, while destination choices remain visibly author-reviewable because the live evidence covers only two cases.
